items.title: Emit selected authored checks as verification-only native C
items.body:
## Scope

Emit hidden wrappers for selected zero-argument #test bodies from their existing checked AST and original source locations. Put eligibility/reachable-effect admission in a small checked Coax policy; native code transports facts and uses the existing emitter. Reject reachable foreign/output effects and unsupported selected forms explicitly; unrelated product host code must not require linking shims. Do not rename original AST declarations.

## Acceptance

Selected/unselected and duplicate display names; loaded-source locations; caller-buffer assertions; reachable foreign refusal; unrelated host procedures pruned; ordinary product C contains no check wrappers/harness.

## Bounds

Acceptance-complete child of r0-native-check-exe. Keep the parent open until every required core and real-consumer gate passes. Coax owns new admission/policy with check-first tests and zero-survivor mutation; hosts perform effects. Finish and push within two hours; commands remain below fifteen minutes. Existing semantic profiles and native-lp64 facts suffice for this bounded native slice; broader target/profile manifests remain workstream 6.

items.title: Run emitted checks with bounded native processes and companion evidence
items.body:
## Scope

Run the same verification artifact under checked O0 and O2 with explicit process/output/time limits and retained native compiler/SDK identities. Define a new versioned native companion record linked to evaluator evidence; do not reinterpret coax.evidence.v1 as native execution. Missing compilation/execution and malformed observations must remain infrastructure error or inconclusive.

## Acceptance

Success and assertion failure; missing compiler/compile error; timeout/output exhaustion; malformed/truncated observation; source/C/executable hashes and exact check selection; default product authority gates unchanged.

items.body:

items.title: Qualify native check traps writes cleanup and a seeded defect
items.body:
## Scope

Qualify authored assertions with independent expected values and guard bytes, exactly-once destination evaluation and reverse cleanup. Separate recognized Coax traps from arbitrary crashes. Seed a defect only into a retained verification artifact and detect it at the affected optimization; reduce bounded quantified inputs while preserving the failure signature.

## Acceptance

Evaluator/O0/O2 agree for supported values/writes/traps/cleanup; seeded native mismatch fails and retains its artifacts; unsupported source minimization is labelled; no test code is shipped.

items.title: Qualify real Verse and Psionic checks with native execution
items.body:
## Scope

Use actual Verse HUD and Psionic tensor/decision checks, preserving all evaluator and physical-source authority obligations. Record selected and unsupported checks, commands, native identities and source-bound outcomes. Large evaluator exhaustion remains inconclusive and authority-unqualified even when a supplemental native test passes; native verification is not a product-gate bypass.

## Acceptance

Actual selected Verse/Psionic checks execute evaluator/O0/O2 as supported; original root/dependency mutation scopes remain distinct; default compile/check failure behavior is retained; source docs and catalogue advertise only the qualified subset.
